# Rob Saric

> Rob Saric is a founder and dad in Ottawa, writing about useful tools for small teams, building companies and life beyond the screen.

Rob is building Caretrics and developing a broader small-team tools direction through Togetheren. SkillNav is in development as part of that direction, beginning with clearer client and project handoffs. This is not a claim of a launched SkillNav product.

## Pages

- [Home](https://robsaric.com/): personal perspective, selected writing, current work and contact.
- [Writing](https://robsaric.com/field-notes/): recent field notes and selected earlier essays. Original dates remain visible.
- [What I'm building](https://robsaric.com/building/): opportunity, ownership and independence through tools for small teams.
- [About](https://robsaric.com/about/): background, building companies, parenting, mentoring and the questions behind Rob's work.
- [Archive](https://robsaric.com/archive/): earlier writing from 2009 to 2019, kept as written.
- [Contact](https://robsaric.com/contact/): rob@caretrics.com
- [Clinic principles](https://robsaric.com/principles/): principles behind the clinic operations work.
- [How I count](https://robsaric.com/how-i-counted/): methods and qualifications for the clinic findings.
- [RSS](https://robsaric.com/rss.xml): published field notes.

## Selected writing

- [Small teams still have to answer the phone](https://robsaric.com/field-notes/2026-10-18-small-teams-deserve-their-time-back/): the responsibilities a team takes on after a prototype becomes a promise.
- [I want my analog life back](https://robsaric.com/field-notes/2026-10-18-building-with-ai-and-life-beyond-the-feed/): useful AI, control of our time and room for life away from screens.
- [Are dashboards going the way of the dodo?](https://robsaric.com/field-notes/2026-10-19-are-dashboards-dead/): where charts help and why operational software needs to help people act.
